gloss: to dote on, to cherish, to be affectionate toward

definitions.gloss: to dote on, to cherish, to lavish affection on
definitions.explanation: To show great affection and care toward someone or something, especially children, pets, or younger people.

examples.japanese: {祖母|そぼ}は{孫|まご}をとても{可愛|かわい}がっている。
{先輩|せんぱい}に{可愛|かわい}がってもらった{思|おも}い{出|で}がたくさんある。
examples.english: I have many memories of being looked after fondly by my seniors.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). Pattern: Xを{可愛|かわい}がる.

ASPECT (ている):
{可愛|かわい}がっている indicates an ongoing habit of showing affection.

WORD FORMATION:
{可愛|かわい}い (cute, lovable) + がる (to show signs of ~) → to show affection toward

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {子|こ}どもを{可愛|かわい}がる: to dote on children
- ペットを{可愛|かわい}がる: to cherish a pet
- {後輩|こうはい}を{可愛|かわい}がる: to look after juniors fondly

NOTE:
In some contexts, especially in sports or martial arts, {可愛|かわい}がる can euphemistically mean to train someone harshly.
